author: Gainsboro Capital
title: Apple ( AAPL ) stock has tumbled over 10% from its high, des
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) stock has tumbled over 10% from its high, despite beating analyst estimates on both the top and bottom line. Although unit sales came in light, iPhone average sale prices came in stronger than ever. 

Source: Apple 
We believe investors were quick to judge Q1 results, overlooking many positive aspects of the earnings report. Although share prices have declined, a buying opportunity has opened up for long-term investors holding the big picture in mind.
Why Q1 Results Aren't So Bad Apple sold ~77.3 million iPhone's in Q1, with an ASP of ~$796 (up $102 from prior year), and crushing analyst ASP estimates of $755 (+5.4% beat).

Source: Business Insider 
The number of units sold came in below analyst estimates of ~81.5 million units - however, when taking into account the fact that the phones sold over a 13-week period (vs. 14-week prior year), the results seem rather attractive.
